authorial_core.source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
authorial_core.interpreted_intent: The actual prior user topic is espionage terminology; this current request asks for independent randomized scene tests using the attached image. Arm A independently drew a covered railway flower-stall contact scene. I compared a direct face-to-face envelope exchange with an apparently ordinary flower purchase containing a small, visibly traceable paper handoff; the latter gives the same contact meaning more tension through competing public attentions. The viewer should first feel the reference-guided woman's controlled presence, then notice the suspended transfer and wonder why the two refuse eye contact. These staging choices are authorial and replaceable, not constraints supplied by the user. Reference guides facial appearance and short black bob only; no identity, biography or age is inferred. Saved controls are sensual 1, fetish 0, surreal 0 and creativity 1, so subtle personal magnetism supports a restrained plausible scene.
authorial_core.subject: A reference-guided woman and an apparently unrelated commuter at a public flower stall.
authorial_core.setting: A covered railway-station flower stall, rainy morning.
authorial_core.event: Clandestine human contact realized as a small folded-paper handoff while public attentions diverge.
visual_priorities: Readable shared paper and two independently owned hands in one view
Reference-guided face and short black bob
Divergent public attention within an ordinary busy concourse
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A tense espionage photograph centered on a reference-guided woman, a moment of clandestine human contact at a covered railway-station flower stall on a rainy morning. Use the supplied reference image for her soft oval facial proportions and dark eyes, and her short black bob with a wispy parted fringe. She is choosing a paper-wrapped bunch of white chrysanthemums in a charcoal wool coat; her restrained, alert presence and the pale window light across her cheek give her a quiet personal magnetism. A man in an ordinary brown commuter jacket stands immediately to her left, screen right, their shoulders angled slightly away from one another. At waist height in the open gap between their bodies, her left thumb and forefinger pinch the near edge of one small folded cream paper while his right thumb and forefinger still hold its opposite edge. Both wrists and the forearms connecting these hands to their respective bodies are visible. Her right hand supports the flower stems against her own chest. Her eyes stay on the flower display while his face turns toward the blurred departure board above the concourse; the little paper crossing the gap is the shared action that contradicts their separate public attentions. Water-darkened coats of passing commuters make a soft moving band behind the pair, and the florist's metal buckets leave a clear visual opening around the transfer. Photograph from the customer side of the stall in a horizontal waist-up two-person frame, at the woman's chest height with a natural 50mm perspective. Hold her face, his reaching hand, her receiving hand and the whole folded paper on the same readable focus plane. The chrysanthemums lead the eye down to the suspended transfer, then back to her watchful face. Cool diffuse daylight from the concourse glazing and a restrained warm bulb above the flowers make the skin, crumpled wrapping and wet floor feel tangible, with modest film grain and ordinary photographic realism.

baseline_review.summary: Two standing human bodies make a light paper transfer through their adjacent left/right hands while the woman holds a bouquet in her separate right hand. Arm chains, reachable space and view of contact are established together.

body_ownership.reason: Her left receiving hand and right flower-supporting hand are distinct; his right hand reaches from the adjacent body. No hand is assigned to more than one person.
prompt_evidence: her left thumb and forefinger pinch the near edge
his right thumb and forefinger still hold its opposite edge
Her right hand supports the flower stems against her own chest

joint_chain_and_reach.reason: The man stands directly beside her on her anatomical left, screen right in the front three-quarter view. Their adjacent arms can reach into the waist-height gap with modest elbow extension. Visible wrists and forearms prevent a disconnected hand interpretation.
prompt_evidence: stands immediately to her left, screen right
Both wrists and the forearms connecting these hands to their respective bodies are visible

support_and_balance.reason: Both subjects stand on the concourse floor; neither leans on the other or bears the other's load. The woman supports the light bouquet against her own torso with her free right hand.
prompt_evidence: Her right hand supports the flower stems against her own chest

contact_and_space.reason: One small folded paper is simultaneously pinched at opposite edges by the two adjacent hands; fingers do not overlap. The open space between bodies and the counter opening make a viable local transfer zone.
prompt_evidence: At waist height in the open gap between their bodies
her left thumb and forefinger pinch the near edge of one small folded cream paper
his right thumb and forefinger still hold its opposite edge

visibility_and_projection.reason: The camera stands on the customer side at chest height in a waist-up two-shot; the transfer is below the bouquet and inside an intentional gap in buckets. Face and both hands share a planned focus plane so an essential contact is not delegated to unseen space.
prompt_evidence: Hold her face, his reaching hand, her receiving hand and the whole folded paper on the same readable focus plane
the florist's metal buckets leave a clear visual opening around the transfer
